description: Use when an agent needs an exact time conversion with the right daylight-saving rules. Returns an ISO time or epoch in any IANA time zone: local time with offset, weekday, abbreviation, DST flag and epoch. Defaults to now in UTC. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

at.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an offset, or epoch seconds or milliseconds; default now

tz.description: IANA zone such as Europe/Chisinau or America/New_York, default UTC

name: get_time

data.description: the get_time payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_time

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Time zone conversion
